params.prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Developer tooling identity. Two bold code brackets form a protective docking cradle around a small upright rounded rectangular device, with one tiny connection dot. Distinctive asymmetric silhouette. Flat charcoal #20242C and lime #B7E34B. Precise technical monospace Berth wordmark, welcoming rather than hacker cliche.
